subject: pharmacology
title: Targeted anticancer: kinase inhibitors, antibodies and immunotherapy

steps.tx: **Imatinib** transformed chronic myeloid leukaemia by blocking the abnormal BCR ABL kinase that drives the disease. It also treats gastrointestinal stromal tumours with activating KIT mutations in specialist oncology practice. Periorbital oedema, muscle cramps and low blood counts limit treatment for many patients on long therapy. **Resistance** mutations change drug choice, and the gatekeeper mutation needs ponatinib rather than standard agents in sequence. Regular molecular monitoring of transcript levels tells the team when response milestones fail.
steps.say: Imatinib transformed chronic myeloid leukaemia by blocking the abnormal kinase that drives the disease in most patients. It also treats gastrointestinal stromal tumours with activating mutations in specialist oncology practice across many centres today. Swelling around the eyes, muscle cramps and low blood counts limit treatment during long therapy courses given. Resistance mutations change drug choice and molecular monitoring tells the team when response milestones fail during follow up. Regular blood testing guides switching before overt relapse develops in treated patients over time ahead.

steps.tx: This high power blood film shows a **left shifted** myeloid series with myelocytes and band forms crowding the field. Dark granular **basophils** stand out among the precursors and they point strongly toward chronic myeloid leukaemia in chronic phase. Mature neutrophils mix with immature forms because the marrow releases cells at every stage of maturation together. This picture explains why a kinase blocker that targets the driving fusion protein controls the counts so dramatically. Examiners use basophilia with left shift as the visual clue for this diagnosis.
steps.say: This high power blood film shows immature myeloid cells crowding the field with band forms and myelocytes together. Dark granular cells stand out among the precursors and they point strongly toward chronic myeloid leukaemia in chronic phase. Mature neutrophils mix with immature forms because the marrow releases cells at every maturation stage together daily here. This picture explains why a kinase blocker controls the counts so dramatically in treated patients over months ahead. Examiners use this visual pattern as the clue for the diagnosis in practical examinations held regularly.

steps.tx: Drugs against **EGFR** treat lung cancers with sensitising mutations and produce an acneiform rash in many patients. Rash severity often predicts response, while diarrhoea and interstitial lung disease limit treatment in others during therapy. Newer agents cover the common resistance mutation and penetrate the brain, but they prolong cardiac conduction in susceptible patients. **Trastuzumab** targets HER2 positive breast cancer and injures cardiac muscle, so ejection fraction monitoring accompanies every course safely. Mutation testing before treatment gates every choice in this group.
steps.say: Drugs against one growth receptor treat lung cancers with sensitising mutations and produce a rash in patients. Rash severity often predicts response while diarrhoea and lung injury limit treatment in others during therapy courses. Newer agents cover the common resistance mutation and they penetrate the brain effectively in metastatic disease treated. Another antibody targets breast cancer and injures cardiac muscle so ejection fraction monitoring accompanies every course safely given. Mutation testing before treatment gates every choice because unselected patients rarely benefit from these drugs prescribed.

steps.tx: Blocking **VEGF** starves tumours of new vessels but it also impairs normal vascular repair in patients. Bevacizumab causes bleeding, gut perforation, hypertension and proteinuria, so elective surgery waits weeks after the last dose. Combined BRAF and MEK blockade treats mutant melanoma and produces fever that interrupts dosing in many patients during treatment. **CDK4/6 inhibitors** such as palbociclib arrest the cell cycle and cause neutropenia that forces treatment holds between cycles. Hypertension during anti angiogenic therapy usually treats through, while perforation stops the drug forever.
steps.say: Blocking vascular growth signalling starves tumours of new vessels but it also impairs normal vascular repair in patients. One antibody causes bleeding and gut perforation so elective surgery waits weeks after the last dose given safely. Combined pathway blockade treats mutant melanoma and it produces fever that interrupts dosing in many patients treated daily. Cell cycle inhibitors arrest division and they cause neutropenia that forces treatment holds between cycles in clinics regularly. Hypertension usually treats through while perforation stops the drug forever after the event occurs in hospital.

steps.tx: **Ibrutinib** blocks B cell receptor signalling in lymphoid cancers and causes atrial fibrillation with bleeding in older patients. Venetoclax releases apoptosis in leukaemia cells, so a slow weekly ramp with **tumour lysis** monitoring prevents metabolic catastrophe at initiation. Checkpoint inhibitors unleash immunity against cancer and inflame colon, lung, liver and endocrine glands in unpredictable patterns during treatment. High dose steroids treat most immune toxicities while teams hold the immunotherapy drug during severe episodes in hospital. Blood counts, chemistry and thyroid checks accompany every cycle in modern protocols.
steps.say: One oral drug blocks B cell signalling in lymphoid cancers and causes atrial fibrillation with bleeding in older patients. Another drug releases apoptosis in leukaemia cells so a slow ramp prevents metabolic catastrophe at treatment initiation in hospital. Checkpoint inhibitors unleash immunity against cancer and they inflame colon, lung and endocrine glands in unpredictable patterns during treatment. High dose steroids treat most immune toxicities while teams hold immunotherapy during severe episodes in hospital wards safely. Blood counts and chemistry accompany every cycle because toxicities appear without warning in treated patients often.
